name: Melbourne Theatre Company Under 30 tickets
summary: Half-price A- and B-Reserve tickets to MTC mainstage plays for anyone aged 29 and under.
key: Anyone aged 29 and under gets 50% off the adult price for A- or B-Reserve mainstage tickets.
who: Anyone aged 29 and under with valid photo ID.
catches: Not available for Premium seats or Opening Nights.
Prices may vary according to production.

source.label: Melbourne Theatre Company: Ticket Prices and Discounts

evidence.quote: Upon presentation of a valid photo ID, anyone aged 29 and under can purchase A-Reserve or B-Reserve tickets
to mainstage productions at a discount of 50% compared to the adult ticket price.
Under 30s also save 50% on subscription packages.
